decisions.reason: The camera is close to the firm's core space optics capabilities and, given its strong in-house R&D and research links, management is likely to retain it and improve it rather than withdraw it after an early market phase.
A modular navigation camera fits the firm's established knowledge base and future direction toward flexible, reprogrammable systems, so absorptive capacity arguments strongly favor keeping it.

The sensor suite builds directly on the firm's existing navigation and observation competences, and a large R&D-active space supplier would usually keep such a strategically adjacent product to learn and refine it.

Although the LiDAR product appears somewhat less prominently marketed so far, it is still close to the firm's sensor and space-qualification expertise, making continued development and retention more likely than withdrawal.
